evals.prompt: I'm done working on the feature/add-user-auth branch. Commit the changes and create a PR.
evals.expected_output: Commits uncommitted changes, pushes, and creates a draft PR displaying the PR URL. Auto-detects the base branch and performs sensitive file checks.
expectations: Auto-detects the base branch and displays it to the user
Verifies CLI authentication with gh auth status
Checks for sensitive files such as .env
Stages specific files by name instead of using git add -A or git add .
Includes a Co-Authored-By trailer in the commit message
Pushes with git push -u origin HEAD
Creates the PR with gh pr create --draft
Passes the PR body via a temp file and --body-file; never a heredoc
Displays the PR URL and a change summary upon completion

evals.prompt: I modified .env.local and src/config.ts on this branch. Create a PR against main.
evals.expected_output: Warns about the .env.local file and does not commit it without user confirmation. Uses main as the base branch.
expectations: Uses main as the base branch as specified in $ARGUMENTS
Detects .env.local as a sensitive file and warns the user
Does not commit .env.local without user confirmation
Commits src/config.ts normally
Creates the PR with gh pr create --draft --base main

evals.prompt: Create a PR. All changes are already committed and pushed.
evals.expected_output: Skips commit and push steps since they are already done and proceeds directly to PR creation. Also checks for an existing PR.
expectations: Confirms no uncommitted changes via git status and skips the commit step
Detects the branch is already pushed and up-to-date with remote, skipping the push step
Checks for an existing open PR on the branch with gh pr list
Creates a new PR if none exists
Includes the PR URL in the completion report

evals.prompt: Create a PR with --lang zh for this branch.
evals.expected_output: Creates a draft PR whose generated title and body prose are written in Simplified Chinese when no explicit --title is provided, while preserving branch names, task IDs, file paths, commands, labels, and code blocks.
expectations: Accepts --lang zh as a first-class language hint
Writes generated PR title and body prose in Simplified Chinese
Keeps branch names, task IDs, file paths, commands, labels, YAML keys, JSON keys, and code blocks unchanged
Still applies the repository PR template when present
Creates the PR with gh pr create --draft

evals.prompt: Create a PR using --language spanish and --title "[000001-010] Crear tabla de usuarios".
evals.expected_output: Uses the explicit PR title verbatim, writes the PR body prose in Spanish, and preserves machine-readable identifiers unchanged.
expectations: Accepts --language spanish as a first-class language hint
Uses the provided --title value verbatim without translating or regenerating it
Writes generated PR body prose in Spanish
Keeps branch names, task IDs, file paths, commands, labels, YAML keys, JSON keys, and code blocks unchanged
Does not prompt for title/body language because an explicit language hint was provided

evals.prompt: Write a localized PR body for a behavior diff, then for docs-only, using the repository template.
evals.expected_output: Uses already-read diff for optional affected scope and concrete Before/After; localizes to resolved language and respects template. Docs-only omits Impact. No extra acquisition, screenshot or authority change.

evals.prompt: Create a new PR for a feature diff; one change has a route and sourced intent, another has neither.
evals.expected_output: Write capability-based Changes with supported Where/Why only. Group internal changes in one closing item; omit API section for feature-only changes.
expectations: Write capability-based Changes with supported Where/Why only. Group internal changes in one closing item; omit API section for feature-only changes.

evals.prompt: Diff removes DELETE /old, changes auth/schema bound to unchanged GET /items/:id, and adds POST /items. Also refactors a handler internally.
evals.expected_output: Write Removed, Changed, New rows in that order, one Method+Path pair each; omit handler-only refactor rows. Never include hosts, tokens, or query values.
expectations: Write Removed, Changed, New rows in that order, one Method+Path pair each; omit handler-only refactor rows. Never include hosts, tokens, or query values.

evals.prompt: Diff renames GET /old to POST /new and changes response/status of GET /status.
evals.expected_output: Represent rename as Removed GET /old then Changed GET /status then New POST /new. Include route-bound request/response/auth/status changes; omit API heading entirely when none exists.
expectations: Represent rename as Removed GET /old then Changed GET /status then New POST /new. Include route-bound request/response/auth/status changes; omit API heading entirely when none exists.

evals.prompt: Create bodies using a template with Impact, one lacking Changes and Impact, and default body with Design Background.
evals.expected_output: Preserve required template sections. Use matching Changes section or append localized Changes; API follows Impact, otherwise template/default body and any Design Background.
expectations: Preserve required template sections. Use matching Changes section or append localized Changes; API follows Impact, otherwise template/default body and any Design Background.

evals.prompt: Update an existing PR after commit/push; optionally edit its description.
evals.expected_output: Skip Step 7 and pr-body-features-api.md; retain Step 8 remote checks. Do not activate new-body rules on update.
expectations: Skip Step 7 and pr-body-features-api.md; retain Step 8 remote checks. Do not activate new-body rules on update.

evals.prompt: Create API-changing PR bodies in each resolved language en, ko, ja, zh, es.
evals.expected_output: Localize Changes/API headings, Where/Why, prose and change values per reference; preserve Method, Path and machine identifiers. Keep required template sections intact.
expectations: Localize Changes/API headings, Where/Why, prose and change values per reference; preserve Method, Path and machine identifiers. Keep required template sections intact.
